From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealthSync demo request - quick qual & scheduling

Hi Sam —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. I saw your self-serve signup earlier today; happy to set up a short demo to show how we can help with low-latency inference and predictable costs for streaming clinical summarization. Before I lock in a demo, a couple quick qualification questions so we tailor the session:

- Primary use case: am I right that you’re evaluating Redwood for real-time clinical note summarization for provider workflows? Any other use cases (search, embeddings, triage)?
- Expected volume: roughly how many concurrent users/sessions and average request size (tokens) do you expect in Q2/Q3?
- Timeline: are you evaluating now for a POC this quarter, or planning for a later pilot?
- Data sensitivity: will you be sending PHI or do you need private deployment options (VPC/on-prem)?
- Integration preference: API-first, or do you want SDK + managed model endpoint?

If now works, here are a few times I have open this week — pick whatever works and I’ll send an invite:
- Wed 3/3 10:00-10:30 PT
- Wed 3/3 14:00-14:30 PT
- Thu 3/4 09:30-10:00 PT

Or use my calendar: https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/30min

Thanks — looking forward to learning more.

Jonas Weber
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0164

Attachment: HealthSync-RFQ-attachments.zip (contains signup export and brief product one-pager)

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@healthsync.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSync demo request - quick qual & scheduling

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Confirming a few items below to help you prep:

- Primary use case: correct — real-time clinical note summarization and short clinical QA for clinicians in the EHR sidebar. Secondary: embeddings for search across visit notes.
- Expected volume: pilot ~50 clinicians concurrently, ~1k API calls/day, avg request ~400 tokens; goal to scale to 500 concurrent and 10k calls/day within 6 months if pilot is successful.
- Timeline: evaluating now, would like a Q1 pilot (end of Mar / early Apr) if we like the POC results.
- Data sensitivity: will involve PHI. We’ll need details on Private deployment (VPC / customer-managed keys) and SOC2 evidence.
- Integration preference: API-first is fine; we’ll want some SDKs for faster prototyping.

For scheduling — Wed 3/3 10:00 PT works for Alyssa and me. Please send an invite.

Sam Carter
Product Lead, Clinical ML | HealthSync
sam.carter@healthsync.com
